svg.title: Shakunetsu Sakura — Dragon of Falling Petals. Director-approved structure (RUL-2026-10-04-002) / Scorch classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Ember Dragon's Roots forks into Kindled Boughs then Dragon in Full Blossom, or Blossom Dominion then Scorching Hanami. Falling Ember Petals forks into Burning Petal Carpet then Conflagration in Bloom, or Smothering Petal Rain then Deluge of Burning Petals. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Scorch jutsu.

g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Scorch jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Dragon in Full Blossom path + Falling Ember Petals
Scorching Hanami path + Falling Ember Petals
Conflagration in Bloom path + Ember Dragon's Roots
Deluge of Burning Petals path + Ember Dragon's Roots
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · HEAL: Heal
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE SHAKUNETSU SAKURA KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
On a static Heal effect each +1% Heal adds 1 heal power, which heals 10 HP per tick (display conflict under review).
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Director-approved structure (RUL-2026-10-04-002) / Scorch classification / forked tree
